text:
The shareholder ballot is open: investors can instruct their intermediary how to vote on each resolution.

Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.
A rule forbidding different voting choices within the same holding is compulsory; the ballot cannot be submitted unless that condition is satisfied.
For the current ballot, An executed power of attorney supplied by the ultimate investor is not a condition and is expressly unnecessary.
For the current ballot, Bringing loaned securities back into custody before voting is not a condition and is expressly unnecessary.
Operations still needs clarification as to whether A bank-issued attestation of the securities holding is a voting condition.
Revealing the name and identity of the ultimate beneficial investor is compulsory; the ballot cannot be submitted unless that condition is satisfied.
A holder can request Immobilising the positions earmarked for the ballot until the meeting closes voluntarily; this remains optional and does not determine voting eligibility.
For the current ballot, An eligibility rule excluding retail investors from the ballot is not a condition and is expressly unnecessary.
For the current ballot, Registering the voting holder before instructions can be accepted is not a condition and is expressly unnecessary.

For the current ballot, A bank-issued attestation of the securities holding is not a condition and is expressly unnecessary.
For the current ballot, A rule forbidding different voting choices within the same holding is not a condition and is expressly unnecessary.
Operations still needs clarification as to whether Revealing the name and identity of the ultimate beneficial investor is a voting condition.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.
A holder can request Immobilising the positions earmarked for the ballot until the meeting closes voluntarily; this remains optional and does not determine voting eligibility.
For the current ballot, An executed power of attorney supplied by the ultimate investor is not a condition and is expressly unnecessary.
For the current ballot, Bringing loaned securities back into custody before voting is not a condition and is expressly unnecessary.
For the current ballot, Registering the voting holder before instructions can be accepted is not a condition and is expressly unnecessary.
An eligibility rule excluding retail investors from the ballot is compulsory; the ballot cannot be submitted unless that condition is satisfied.

Registering the voting holder before instructions can be accepted is compulsory; the ballot cannot be submitted unless that condition is satisfied.

text:
The shareholder ballot is open: investors can instruct their intermediary how to vote on each resolution.

For the current ballot, Bringing loaned securities back into custody before voting is not a condition and is expressly unnecessary.
For the current ballot, An executed power of attorney supplied by the ultimate investor is not a condition and is expressly unnecessary.
A holder can request Immobilising the positions earmarked for the ballot until the meeting closes voluntarily; this remains optional and does not determine voting eligibility.
A holder can request Revealing the name and identity of the ultimate beneficial investor voluntarily; this remains optional and does not determine voting eligibility.
For the current ballot, A rule forbidding different voting choices within the same holding is not a condition and is expressly unnecessary.
The custodian voting deadline was 15 September 2026 at 12:00 UTC.
A holder can request An eligibility rule excluding retail investors from the ballot voluntarily; this remains optional and does not determine voting eligibility.
For the current ballot, A bank-issued attestation of the securities holding is not a condition and is expressly unnecessary.
Registering the voting holder before instructions can be accepted is compulsory; the ballot cannot be submitted unless that condition is satisfied.

A holder can request Revealing the name and identity of the ultimate beneficial investor voluntarily; this remains optional and does not determine voting eligibility.
For the current ballot, An eligibility rule excluding retail investors from the ballot is not a condition and is expressly unnecessary.

The shareholder ballot is open: investors can instruct their intermediary how to vote on each resolution.

Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.
A holder can request An executed power of attorney supplied by the ultimate investor voluntarily; this remains optional and does not determine voting eligibility.
Immobilising the positions earmarked for the ballot until the meeting closes is compulsory; the ballot cannot be submitted unless that condition is satisfied.
A rule forbidding different voting choices within the same holding is compulsory; the ballot cannot be submitted unless that condition is satisfied.
Registering the voting holder before instructions can be accepted is compulsory; the ballot cannot be submitted unless that condition is satisfied.
For the current ballot, Revealing the name and identity of the ultimate beneficial investor is not a condition and is expressly unnecessary.
A holder can request An eligibility rule excluding retail investors from the ballot voluntarily; this remains optional and does not determine voting eligibility.
Bringing loaned securities back into custody before voting is compulsory; the ballot cannot be submitted unless that condition is satisfied.
A holder can request A bank-issued attestation of the securities holding voluntarily; this remains optional and does not determine voting eligibility.

passage_states.text: The shareholder ballot is open: investors can instruct their intermediary how to vote on each resolution.
A holder can request An executed power of attorney supplied by the ultimate investor voluntarily; this remains optional and does not determine voting eligibility.
A rule forbidding different voting choices within the same holding is compulsory; the ballot cannot be submitted unless that condition is satisfied.
For the current ballot, Revealing the name and identity of the ultimate beneficial investor is not a condition and is expressly unnecessary.
For the current ballot, A bank-issued attestation of the securities holding is not a condition and is expressly unnecessary.
Registering the voting holder before instructions can be accepted is compulsory; the ballot cannot be submitted unless that condition is satisfied.
Immobilising the positions earmarked for the ballot until the meeting closes is compulsory; the ballot cannot be submitted unless that condition is satisfied.
A holder can request Bringing loaned securities back into custody before voting voluntarily; this remains optional and does not determine voting eligibility.
For the current ballot, An eligibility rule excluding retail investors from the ballot is not a condition and is expressly unnecessary.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.

For the current ballot, Immobilising the positions earmarked for the ballot until the meeting closes is not a condition and is expressly unnecessary.
For the current ballot, A bank-issued attestation of the securities holding is not a condition and is expressly unnecessary.
A holder can request Revealing the name and identity of the ultimate beneficial investor voluntarily; this remains optional and does not determine voting eligibility.
A holder can request A rule forbidding different voting choices within the same holding voluntarily; this remains optional and does not determine voting eligibility.
A holder can request An executed power of attorney supplied by the ultimate investor voluntarily; this remains optional and does not determine voting eligibility.
A holder can request Registering the voting holder before instructions can be accepted voluntarily; this remains optional and does not determine voting eligibility.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.
For the current ballot, Bringing loaned securities back into custody before voting is not a condition and is expressly unnecessary.

For the current ballot, Registering the voting holder before instructions can be accepted is not a condition and is expressly unnecessary.

text:
The shareholder ballot is open: investors can instruct their intermediary how to vote on each resolution.

A holder can request Bringing loaned securities back into custody before voting voluntarily; this remains optional and does not determine voting eligibility.
For the current ballot, An executed power of attorney supplied by the ultimate investor is not a condition and is expressly unnecessary.
For the current ballot, A rule forbidding different voting choices within the same holding is not a condition and is expressly unnecessary.
For the current ballot, Immobilising the positions earmarked for the ballot until the meeting closes is not a condition and is expressly unnecessary.
Revealing the name and identity of the ultimate beneficial investor is compulsory; the ballot cannot be submitted unless that condition is satisfied.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.
A holder can request An eligibility rule excluding retail investors from the ballot voluntarily; this remains optional and does not determine voting eligibility.
For the current ballot, Registering the voting holder before instructions can be accepted is not a condition and is expressly unnecessary.
A bank-issued attestation of the securities holding is compulsory; the ballot cannot be submitted unless that condition is satisfied.

The shareholder ballot is open: investors can instruct their intermediary how to vote on each resolution.

Registering the voting holder before instructions can be accepted is compulsory; the ballot cannot be submitted unless that condition is satisfied.
An eligibility rule excluding retail investors from the ballot is compulsory; the ballot cannot be submitted unless that condition is satisfied.
For the current ballot, A rule forbidding different voting choices within the same holding is not a condition and is expressly unnecessary.
An executed power of attorney supplied by the ultimate investor is compulsory; the ballot cannot be submitted unless that condition is satisfied.
A holder can request A bank-issued attestation of the securities holding voluntarily; this remains optional and does not determine voting eligibility.
A holder can request Revealing the name and identity of the ultimate beneficial investor voluntarily; this remains optional and does not determine voting eligibility.
Immobilising the positions earmarked for the ballot until the meeting closes is compulsory; the ballot cannot be submitted unless that condition is satisfied.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.
For the current ballot, Bringing loaned securities back into custody before voting is not a condition and is expressly unnecessary.

A holder can request A bank-issued attestation of the securities holding voluntarily; this remains optional and does not determine voting eligibility.
For the current ballot, An eligibility rule excluding retail investors from the ballot is not a condition and is expressly unnecessary.
Registering the voting holder before instructions can be accepted is compulsory; the ballot cannot be submitted unless that condition is satisfied.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.
A holder can request Bringing loaned securities back into custody before voting voluntarily; this remains optional and does not determine voting eligibility.
An executed power of attorney supplied by the ultimate investor is compulsory; the ballot cannot be submitted unless that condition is satisfied.
For the current ballot, Immobilising the positions earmarked for the ballot until the meeting closes is not a condition and is expressly unnecessary.
A holder can request Revealing the name and identity of the ultimate beneficial investor voluntarily; this remains optional and does not determine voting eligibility.

A rule forbidding different voting choices within the same holding is compulsory; the ballot cannot be submitted unless that condition is satisfied.
Operations still needs clarification as to whether Revealing the name and identity of the ultimate beneficial investor is a voting condition.

The shareholder ballot is open: investors can instruct their intermediary how to vote on each resolution.

Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.
For the current ballot, An eligibility rule excluding retail investors from the ballot is not a condition and is expressly unnecessary.
Revealing the name and identity of the ultimate beneficial investor is compulsory; the ballot cannot be submitted unless that condition is satisfied.
Operations still needs clarification as to whether An executed power of attorney supplied by the ultimate investor is a voting condition.
A holder can request A rule forbidding different voting choices within the same holding voluntarily; this remains optional and does not determine voting eligibility.
For the current ballot, Registering the voting holder before instructions can be accepted is not a condition and is expressly unnecessary.
A holder can request A bank-issued attestation of the securities holding voluntarily; this remains optional and does not determine voting eligibility.
For the current ballot, Bringing loaned securities back into custody before voting is not a condition and is expressly unnecessary.
A holder can request Immobilising the positions earmarked for the ballot until the meeting closes voluntarily; this remains optional and does not determine voting eligibility.

text:
The shareholder ballot is open: investors can instruct their intermediary how to vote on each resolution.

The custodian voting deadline was 15 September 2026 at 12:00 UTC.
For the current ballot, An executed power of attorney supplied by the ultimate investor is not a condition and is expressly unnecessary.
A holder can request A bank-issued attestation of the securities holding voluntarily; this remains optional and does not determine voting eligibility.
For the current ballot, A rule forbidding different voting choices within the same holding is not a condition and is expressly unnecessary.
Bringing loaned securities back into custody before voting is compulsory; the ballot cannot be submitted unless that condition is satisfied.
For the current ballot, Immobilising the positions earmarked for the ballot until the meeting closes is not a condition and is expressly unnecessary.
For the current ballot, An eligibility rule excluding retail investors from the ballot is not a condition and is expressly unnecessary.
Revealing the name and identity of the ultimate beneficial investor is compulsory; the ballot cannot be submitted unless that condition is satisfied.
A holder can request Registering the voting holder before instructions can be accepted voluntarily; this remains optional and does not determine voting eligibility.

An eligibility rule excluding retail investors from the ballot is compulsory; the ballot cannot be submitted unless that condition is satisfied.
A holder can request Immobilising the positions earmarked for the ballot until the meeting closes voluntarily; this remains optional and does not determine voting eligibility.
A rule forbidding different voting choices within the same holding is compulsory; the ballot cannot be submitted unless that condition is satisfied.

For the current ballot, Bringing loaned securities back into custody before voting is not a condition and is expressly unnecessary.
Operations still needs clarification as to whether A rule forbidding different voting choices within the same holding is a voting condition.
For the current ballot, Registering the voting holder before instructions can be accepted is not a condition and is expressly unnecessary.
A holder can request An eligibility rule excluding retail investors from the ballot voluntarily; this remains optional and does not determine voting eligibility.
Immobilising the positions earmarked for the ballot until the meeting closes is compulsory; the ballot cannot be submitted unless that condition is satisfied.
A bank-issued attestation of the securities holding is compulsory; the ballot cannot be submitted unless that condition is satisfied.
For the current ballot, An executed power of attorney supplied by the ultimate investor is not a condition and is expressly unnecessary.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.
For the current ballot, Revealing the name and identity of the ultimate beneficial investor is not a condition and is expressly unnecessary.

A holder can request Revealing the name and identity of the ultimate beneficial investor voluntarily; this remains optional and does not determine voting eligibility.
A holder can request A rule forbidding different voting choices within the same holding voluntarily; this remains optional and does not determine voting eligibility.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.
An executed power of attorney supplied by the ultimate investor is compulsory; the ballot cannot be submitted unless that condition is satisfied.

For the current ballot, Registering the voting holder before instructions can be accepted is not a condition and is expressly unnecessary.
A rule forbidding different voting choices within the same holding is compulsory; the ballot cannot be submitted unless that condition is satisfied.
For the current ballot, Immobilising the positions earmarked for the ballot until the meeting closes is not a condition and is expressly unnecessary.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.

Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.
A holder can request An executed power of attorney supplied by the ultimate investor voluntarily; this remains optional and does not determine voting eligibility.
A rule forbidding different voting choices within the same holding is compulsory; the ballot cannot be submitted unless that condition is satisfied.
For the current ballot, Revealing the name and identity of the ultimate beneficial investor is not a condition and is expressly unnecessary.
For the current ballot, Bringing loaned securities back into custody before voting is not a condition and is expressly unnecessary.

The shareholder ballot is open: investors can instruct their intermediary how to vote on each resolution.

Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.
Immobilising the positions earmarked for the ballot until the meeting closes is compulsory; the ballot cannot be submitted unless that condition is satisfied.
A holder can request Bringing loaned securities back into custody before voting voluntarily; this remains optional and does not determine voting eligibility.
A holder can request An executed power of attorney supplied by the ultimate investor voluntarily; this remains optional and does not determine voting eligibility.
A rule forbidding different voting choices within the same holding is compulsory; the ballot cannot be submitted unless that condition is satisfied.
A holder can request Registering the voting holder before instructions can be accepted voluntarily; this remains optional and does not determine voting eligibility.
For the current ballot, Revealing the name and identity of the ultimate beneficial investor is not a condition and is expressly unnecessary.
For the current ballot, An eligibility rule excluding retail investors from the ballot is not a condition and is expressly unnecessary.
A holder can request A bank-issued attestation of the securities holding voluntarily; this remains optional and does not determine voting eligibility.

The shareholder ballot is open: investors can instruct their intermediary how to vote on each resolution.

Immobilising the positions earmarked for the ballot until the meeting closes is compulsory; the ballot cannot be submitted unless that condition is satisfied.
A holder can request Revealing the name and identity of the ultimate beneficial investor voluntarily; this remains optional and does not determine voting eligibility.
For the current ballot, An executed power of attorney supplied by the ultimate investor is not a condition and is expressly unnecessary.
A holder can request Registering the voting holder before instructions can be accepted voluntarily; this remains optional and does not determine voting eligibility.

A holder can request Registering the voting holder before instructions can be accepted voluntarily; this remains optional and does not determine voting eligibility.
A holder can request Immobilising the positions earmarked for the ballot until the meeting closes voluntarily; this remains optional and does not determine voting eligibility.
An eligibility rule excluding retail investors from the ballot is compulsory; the ballot cannot be submitted unless that condition is satisfied.

A holder can request An eligibility rule excluding retail investors from the ballot voluntarily; this remains optional and does not determine voting eligibility.
A holder can request A bank-issued attestation of the securities holding voluntarily; this remains optional and does not determine voting eligibility.
For the current ballot, An executed power of attorney supplied by the ultimate investor is not a condition and is expressly unnecessary.
A holder can request Immobilising the positions earmarked for the ballot until the meeting closes voluntarily; this remains optional and does not determine voting eligibility.
The custodian voting deadline was 15 September 2026 at 12:00 UTC.
A holder can request Registering the voting holder before instructions can be accepted voluntarily; this remains optional and does not determine voting eligibility.
For the current ballot, Bringing loaned securities back into custody before voting is not a condition and is expressly unnecessary.
A holder can request Revealing the name and identity of the ultimate beneficial investor voluntarily; this remains optional and does not determine voting eligibility.

The shareholder ballot is open: investors can instruct their intermediary how to vote on each resolution.

A rule forbidding different voting choices within the same holding is compulsory; the ballot cannot be submitted unless that condition is satisfied.
A holder can request Revealing the name and identity of the ultimate beneficial investor voluntarily; this remains optional and does not determine voting eligibility.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.
For the current ballot, An executed power of attorney supplied by the ultimate investor is not a condition and is expressly unnecessary.
A bank-issued attestation of the securities holding is compulsory; the ballot cannot be submitted unless that condition is satisfied.
A holder can request Immobilising the positions earmarked for the ballot until the meeting closes voluntarily; this remains optional and does not determine voting eligibility.
Bringing loaned securities back into custody before voting is compulsory; the ballot cannot be submitted unless that condition is satisfied.
For the current ballot, Registering the voting holder before instructions can be accepted is not a condition and is expressly unnecessary.
For the current ballot, An eligibility rule excluding retail investors from the ballot is not a condition and is expressly unnecessary.

For the current ballot, Revealing the name and identity of the ultimate beneficial investor is not a condition and is expressly unnecessary.
A holder can request An executed power of attorney supplied by the ultimate investor voluntarily; this remains optional and does not determine voting eligibility.
A bank-issued attestation of the securities holding is compulsory; the ballot cannot be submitted unless that condition is satisfied.
For the current ballot, A rule forbidding different voting choices within the same holding is not a condition and is expressly unnecessary.
An eligibility rule excluding retail investors from the ballot is compulsory; the ballot cannot be submitted unless that condition is satisfied.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.
A holder can request Registering the voting holder before instructions can be accepted voluntarily; this remains optional and does not determine voting eligibility.
Bringing loaned securities back into custody before voting is compulsory; the ballot cannot be submitted unless that condition is satisfied.

Bringing loaned securities back into custody before voting is compulsory; the ballot cannot be submitted unless that condition is satisfied.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.
A bank-issued attestation of the securities holding is compulsory; the ballot cannot be submitted unless that condition is satisfied.
For the current ballot, Registering the voting holder before instructions can be accepted is not a condition and is expressly unnecessary.
A holder can request Revealing the name and identity of the ultimate beneficial investor voluntarily; this remains optional and does not determine voting eligibility.
For the current ballot, An eligibility rule excluding retail investors from the ballot is not a condition and is expressly unnecessary.
For the current ballot, A rule forbidding different voting choices within the same holding is not a condition and is expressly unnecessary.
A holder can request Immobilising the positions earmarked for the ballot until the meeting closes voluntarily; this remains optional and does not determine voting eligibility.

Revealing the name and identity of the ultimate beneficial investor is compulsory; the ballot cannot be submitted unless that condition is satisfied.
An executed power of attorney supplied by the ultimate investor is compulsory; the ballot cannot be submitted unless that condition is satisfied.

The shareholder ballot is open: investors can instruct their intermediary how to vote on each resolution.

A holder can request Revealing the name and identity of the ultimate beneficial investor voluntarily; this remains optional and does not determine voting eligibility.
For the current ballot, An executed power of attorney supplied by the ultimate investor is not a condition and is expressly unnecessary.

Immobilising the positions earmarked for the ballot until the meeting closes is compulsory; the ballot cannot be submitted unless that condition is satisfied.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.
A holder can request A bank-issued attestation of the securities holding voluntarily; this remains optional and does not determine voting eligibility.
A rule forbidding different voting choices within the same holding is compulsory; the ballot cannot be submitted unless that condition is satisfied.
A holder can request Registering the voting holder before instructions can be accepted voluntarily; this remains optional and does not determine voting eligibility.
For the current ballot, An eligibility rule excluding retail investors from the ballot is not a condition and is expressly unnecessary.
For the current ballot, An executed power of attorney supplied by the ultimate investor is not a condition and is expressly unnecessary.
Revealing the name and identity of the ultimate beneficial investor is compulsory; the ballot cannot be submitted unless that condition is satisfied.

A holder can request Registering the voting holder before instructions can be accepted voluntarily; this remains optional and does not determine voting eligibility.
For the current ballot, Bringing loaned securities back into custody before voting is not a condition and is expressly unnecessary.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.
Revealing the name and identity of the ultimate beneficial investor is compulsory; the ballot cannot be submitted unless that condition is satisfied.
